name: Axiomatic Polymorph Trap
description: A Utopian glyph transforms trespassers into aeons.
disable: DC 48 Thievery (master) to drain the glyph's power harmlessly, or Dispel Magic (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the glyph

generalAbilities.name: Axiomatic Polymorph
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of the entryway to the Hall of Wonders (area N4) without speaking the passphrase ("The History and Future of Humanity") in Utopian

Effect Each creature within 20 feet of the door is targeted by Cursed Metamorphosis (DC 42 Will Saving Throw save), except the effect transforms creatures into the form of an Arbiter aeon rather than that of an animal.
